# ex: needParen adds parens when binary expr replaces Fun position of CallExpr
ex {
	var x int
	f(x) -> x + 1
}
-- x.go --
package p

func f(x int) func() int { return nil }

func h(a int) {
	_ = f(a)()
}
-- stderr --
x.go:6:6: invalid operation: cannot call (a + 1) (value of type int): int is not a function
errors found after executing: ex { \ ...
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -3,5 +3,5 @@
 func f(x int) func() int { return nil }

 func h(a int) {
-	_ = f(a)()
+	_ = (a + 1)()
 }
